name: Philly Cheesesteak Rice Bowl
desc: Thin-sliced seared ribeye with onion, peppers and mushrooms over rice, smothered in a provolone cheese sauce.

source.title: Philly Cheesesteak Rice Bowl
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 8 oz white or cremini mushrooms, sliced
Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste
1 3/4 cups shredded provolone cheese (or 8 slices white American cheese, torn)
ingredients.note: or 8 slices white American cheese, torn

steps: Freeze the steak 30 to 45 min, until firm but not frozen through, then slice it paper thin against the grain.

Make the cheese sauce: melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook 1 min. Whisk in the milk and simmer, whisking, 3 to 5 min, until thickened. Add the cheese and salt and whisk until smooth. Cover and keep warm.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat until very hot. Add the steak in a single layer (in batches if needed) and sear undisturbed until browned, then toss 1 to 2 min more. Season with salt and pepper and move to a plate.

Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onion, both peppers and the mushrooms, stirring occasionally, 6 to 8 min, until soft and browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Return the steak to the skillet and toss with the vegetables.
Divide the rice among 4 bowls, top with the steak and vegetables, and pour the warm cheese sauce over each bowl.
tips: Partly freezing the steak is what lets you slice it thin enough to sear in a minute or two.
